# ProductTally

> Independent, evidence-led notes on SaaS, software, and digital products for creators and small teams.

ProductTally product pages explain product positioning, supported features, practical uses, advantages, and relevant plan conditions, with official evidence, product imagery, demonstrations, and related guides. Guides provide practical workflows and evidence-led recommendations.

## Editorial principles
- Separate observed results from features not tested.
- Prefer official product documentation as a source.
- Product links lead to official vendor destinations.
